10 اشتنكرهُ : see 4, first signification, and also in the latter part. ―
-b2- اِسْتِنْكَارٌ also signifies The inquiring respecting, or seeking to understand, a thing, or an affair, which one disapproves; (K, TA;) when one disapproves confirming, or establishing, the opinion expressed by an inquirer, or disapproves that his opinion should be contrary to what he has expressed. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
